subject.title: transcripts: show prints stored terminal escapes from imported text

question: Should transcript terminal-control sanitization happen when generating stored `summary.md`, when printing `transcripts show`, or in both places?
rationale: All options can remove the stdout hazard, but they choose different semantics for persisted human-readable artifacts and security handling.

options.title: Sanitize generated Markdown
options.body: Strip terminal controls from externally supplied transcript text and speaker labels before rendering `summary.md`, making the stored artifact and CLI display safe by default.

options.title: Sanitize only CLI output
options.body: Preserve stored artifact bytes and strip terminal controls only before stdout, but separately accept that opening `summary.md` directly can still affect a terminal.

options.title: Route through security first
options.body: Pause repair work until security owners decide whether this already-public terminal-control issue needs advisory-style handling.

recommendation.title: Sanitize generated Markdown
recommendation.body: Strip terminal controls from externally supplied transcript text and speaker labels before rendering `summary.md`, making the stored artifact and CLI display safe by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest current history on the transcript summary/store/CLI surface and is the best available owner for the boundary choice.
